reason: Gate and fixture compatibility: Reject added blanket lint exemptions and hardcoded /tmp artifact paths. Historical Runtime::new return-shape, unchecked old WorkflowParts fields and renamed private test modules are not independent behavior. Current fallible constructors and persistent configured scratch remain authoritative; retained behavioral assertions are disposed separately. AnswerAsk wire slot field rejected; ticket authority retained: Literal answer_slot:SlotIdx replaces ticket:u64 and shrinks max-u64 selector roundtrip to u16 slot boundaries. Current payload still carries ticket; server resolves step0..65535 or checked slot-offset65536..131071 to a unique actual pending AskTicket. Preserve current layout and actual issued ticket/run_attempt/fencing authority; no direct slot field or fabricated ticket is adopted. Bounded-read refusal before cursor consumption: Added cases cover limits1/256/65536, zero/equal/one-below/one-above, u32MAX declaration, exact PayloadTooLarge{actual,limit}, unchanged reader position on refusal, exact accepted bytes and PayloadDecodeFailed for truncated accepted-length data. Current read_frame_payload_bounded checks validate_frame_bounds before allocation/read. Preserve these concrete error/nonmutation assertions through valid flags and typed MaxPayloadBytes. A returned Vec.len assertion alone does not measure allocation capacity or prove allocator bounds. Exact command/payload/response and numeric conversion properties: Old/new assertions retain concrete full typed payload identity, header fields, strict-greater-than payload bounds and u32->usize results. Historical whole-root tests now live in tests_ipc_basic/errors_frames/proptests; function map binds actual bodies and exact assertions, not filenames. Keep those oracles with current command inventory including18, current typed completion ticket authority and valid flags; u32MAX success is target-width dependent and must not erase PayloadLengthOutOfRange on narrower targets. Invalid sender-drop rewrite rejected: Authored disconnected test constructs receiver_only as a complete MemoryIngress, drops only producer(), then expects Disconnected. The struct retains its internal sender, so an empty queue correctly returns Ok(None). Current receiver-only crossbeam fixture drops both original queue and final cloned sender before asserting disconnection; preserve that real producer lifecycle. Legacy capability envelope rejected specifically: Authored tests repurpose header bytes10..12 into a caller capability bitmap: zero=>PermissionDenied, nonzero=>accepted/preserved ROOT or arbitrary bits, sometimes before payload bounds. Current v1 header encodes zero in those reserved bytes and rejects any nonzero with ReservedNonZero; no caller-auth capability word exists. Reject exactly those bitmap/sentinel/precedence expectations without adding auth, ABI fields or permission behavior.

Current read_frame_payload_bounded checks validate_frame_bounds before allocation/read. Preserve these concrete error/nonmutation assertions through valid flags and typed MaxPayloadBytes. A returned Vec.len assertion alone does not measure allocation capacity or prove allocator bounds.

per_intent.reason: Authored disconnected test constructs receiver_only as a complete MemoryIngress, drops only producer(), then expects Disconnected. The struct retains its internal sender, so an empty queue correctly returns Ok(None). Current receiver-only crossbeam fixture drops both original queue and final cloned sender before asserting disconnection; preserve that real producer lifecycle.

Authored tests repurpose header bytes10..12 into a caller capability bitmap: zero=>PermissionDenied, nonzero=>accepted/preserved ROOT or arbitrary bits, sometimes before payload bounds. Current v1 header encodes zero in those reserved bytes and rejects any nonzero with ReservedNonZero; no caller-auth capability word exists. Reject exactly those bitmap/sentinel/precedence expectations without adding auth, ABI fields or permission behavior.

reason: Gate and fixture compatibility: Reject added blanket lint exemptions and hardcoded /tmp artifact paths. Historical Runtime::new return-shape, unchecked old WorkflowParts fields and renamed private test modules are not independent behavior. Current fallible constructors and persistent configured scratch remain authoritative; retained behavioral assertions are disposed separately. Legacy capability envelope rejected specifically: Authored tests repurpose header bytes10..12 into a caller capability bitmap: zero=>PermissionDenied, nonzero=>accepted/preserved ROOT or arbitrary bits, sometimes before payload bounds. Current v1 header encodes zero in those reserved bytes and rejects any nonzero with ReservedNonZero; no caller-auth capability word exists. Reject exactly those bitmap/sentinel/precedence expectations without adding auth, ABI fields or permission behavior. Bounded-read refusal before cursor consumption: Added cases cover limits1/256/65536, zero/equal/one-below/one-above, u32MAX declaration, exact PayloadTooLarge{actual,limit}, unchanged reader position on refusal, exact accepted bytes and PayloadDecodeFailed for truncated accepted-length data. Current read_frame_payload_bounded checks validate_frame_bounds before allocation/read. Preserve these concrete error/nonmutation assertions through valid flags and typed MaxPayloadBytes. A returned Vec.len assertion alone does not measure allocation capacity or prove allocator bounds. Unknown header command preservation: Historical helper names say rejected but body changes accept UnknownCommand for0/65535/unrecognized IDs. Current from_u16 preserves unsupported raw IDs in UnknownCommand and dispatch returns UnsupportedCommand; header acceptance is not runtime command acceptance. Keep exact field/correlation/payload/flag and dispatch-refusal oracle separation through real decoder. Per-command flag validity and exact framing assertions: Positive encode/decode fixtures using arbitrary/all flags, Health0x55AA or flags0xFFFF conflict with CommandFlags reserved-global0xFF00 and per-command valid masks. Keep exact magic/version/command/correlation/length/byte roundtrip and rejection-field intents using a valid command/flag pair; invalid flags need the actual ReservedBitsSet/InvalidCommandFlags result, not weakened validation.

reason: Gate and fixture compatibility: Reject added blanket lint exemptions and hardcoded /tmp artifact paths. Historical Runtime::new return-shape, unchecked old WorkflowParts fields and renamed private test modules are not independent behavior. Current fallible constructors and persistent configured scratch remain authoritative; retained behavioral assertions are disposed separately. AnswerAsk wire slot field rejected; ticket authority retained: Literal answer_slot:SlotIdx replaces ticket:u64 and shrinks max-u64 selector roundtrip to u16 slot boundaries. Current payload still carries ticket; server resolves step0..65535 or checked slot-offset65536..131071 to a unique actual pending AskTicket. Preserve current layout and actual issued ticket/run_attempt/fencing authority; no direct slot field or fabricated ticket is adopted. Bounded-read refusal before cursor consumption: Added cases cover limits1/256/65536, zero/equal/one-below/one-above, u32MAX declaration, exact PayloadTooLarge{actual,limit}, unchanged reader position on refusal, exact accepted bytes and PayloadDecodeFailed for truncated accepted-length data. Current read_frame_payload_bounded checks validate_frame_bounds before allocation/read. Preserve these concrete error/nonmutation assertions through valid flags and typed MaxPayloadBytes. A returned Vec.len assertion alone does not measure allocation capacity or prove allocator bounds. Exact command/payload/response and numeric conversion properties: Old/new assertions retain concrete full typed payload identity, header fields, strict-greater-than payload bounds and u32->usize results. Historical whole-root tests now live in tests_ipc_basic/errors_frames/proptests; function map binds actual bodies and exact assertions, not filenames. reason: Gate and fixture compatibility: Reject added blanket lint exemptions and hardcoded /tmp artifact paths. Historical Runtime::new return-shape, unchecked old WorkflowParts fields and renamed private test modules are not independent behavior. Current fallible constructors and persistent configured scratch remain authoritative; retained behavioral assertions are disposed separately. Legacy capability envelope rejected specifically: Authored tests repurpose header bytes10..12 into a caller capability bitmap: zero=>PermissionDenied, nonzero=>accepted/preserved ROOT or arbitrary bits, sometimes before payload bounds. Current v1 header encodes zero in those reserved bytes and rejects any nonzero with ReservedNonZero; no caller-auth capability word exists. Reject exactly those bitmap/sentinel/precedence expectations without adding auth, ABI fields or permission behavior. Bounded-read refusal before cursor consumption: Added cases cover limits1/256/65536, zero/equal/one-below/one-above, u32MAX declaration, exact PayloadTooLarge{actual,limit}, unchanged reader position on refusal, exact accepted bytes and PayloadDecodeFailed for truncated accepted-length data. Current read_frame_payload_bounded checks validate_frame_bounds before allocation/read. Preserve these concrete error/nonmutation assertions through valid flags and typed MaxPayloadBytes. A returned Vec.len assertion alone does not measure allocation capacity or prove allocator bounds. Unknown header command preservation: Historical helper names say rejected but body changes accept UnknownCommand for0/65535/unrecognized IDs. Current from_u16 preserves unsupported raw IDs in UnknownCommand and dispatch returns UnsupportedCommand; header acceptance is not runtime command acceptance. Keep exact field/correlation/payload/flag and dispatch-refusal oracle separation through real decoder. Per-command flag validity and exact framing assertions: Positive encode/decode fixtures using arbitrary/all flags, Health0x55AA or flags0xFFFF conflict with CommandFlags reserved-global0xFF00 and per-command valid masks. Keep exact magic/version/command/correlation/length/byte roundtrip and rejection-field intents using a valid command/flag pair; invalid flags need the actual ReservedBitsSet/InvalidCommandFlags result, not weakened validation.

reason: Gate and fixture compatibility: Reject added blanket lint exemptions and hardcoded /tmp artifact paths. Historical Runtime::new return-shape, unchecked old WorkflowParts fields and renamed private test modules are not independent behavior. Current fallible constructors and persistent configured scratch remain authoritative; retained behavioral assertions are disposed separately. Legacy capability envelope rejected specifically: Authored tests repurpose header bytes10..12 into a caller capability bitmap: zero=>PermissionDenied, nonzero=>accepted/preserved ROOT or arbitrary bits, sometimes before payload bounds. Current v1 header encodes zero in those reserved bytes and rejects any nonzero with ReservedNonZero; no caller-auth capability word exists. Reject exactly those bitmap/sentinel/precedence expectations without adding auth, ABI fields or permission behavior. Socket lifecycle, partial frame and exact server response oracles: Original deltas add bounded unique socket paths, exact bind permissions0o600/existence, process/read/write continuing true, partial/oversized frame bounds, disconnect/midframe recovery, sequential-client health and capacity refusal assertions. Current split impl_tests own many exact bodies, but fixtures/raw envelope expectations and checked runtime construction differ. Preserve actual whole-buffer limits, exact response/connection cleanup and one-client removal assertions using reserved-zero headers and persistent configured scratch; no no-auth capability restoration or broad lint exemptions.

reason: Gate and fixture compatibility: Reject added blanket lint exemptions and hardcoded /tmp artifact paths. Historical Runtime::new return-shape, unchecked old WorkflowParts fields and renamed private test modules are not independent behavior. Current fallible constructors and persistent configured scratch remain authoritative; retained behavioral assertions are disposed separately. AnswerAsk wire slot field rejected; ticket authority retained: Literal answer_slot:SlotIdx replaces ticket:u64 and shrinks max-u64 selector roundtrip to u16 slot boundaries. Current payload still carries ticket; server resolves step0..65535 or checked slot-offset65536..131071 to a unique actual pending AskTicket. Preserve current layout and actual issued ticket/run_attempt/fencing authority; no direct slot field or fabricated ticket is adopted. Bounded-read refusal before cursor consumption: Added cases cover limits1/256/65536, zero/equal/one-below/one-above, u32MAX declaration, exact PayloadTooLarge{actual,limit}, unchanged reader position on refusal, exact accepted bytes and PayloadDecodeFailed for truncated accepted-length data. Current read_frame_payload_bounded checks validate_frame_bounds before allocation/read. Preserve these concrete error/nonmutation assertions through valid flags and typed MaxPayloadBytes. A returned Vec.len assertion alone does not measure allocation capacity or prove allocator bounds. Exact command/payload/response and numeric conversion properties: Old/new assertions retain concrete full typed payload identity, header fields, strict-greater-than payload bounds and u32->usize results. Historical whole-root tests now live in tests_ipc_basic/errors_frames/proptests; function map binds actual bodies and exact assertions, not filenames. Keep those oracles with current command inventory including18, current typed completion ticket authority and valid flags; u32MAX success is target-width dependent and must not erase PayloadLengthOutOfRange on narrower targets. Invalid sender-drop rewrite rejected: Authored disconnected test constructs receiver_only as a complete MemoryIngress, drops only producer(), then expects Disconnected. The struct retains its internal sender, so an empty queue correctly returns Ok(None). Current receiver-only crossbeam fixture drops both original queue and final cloned sender before asserting disconnection; preserve that real producer lifecycle. Legacy capability envelope rejected specifically: Authored tests repurpose header bytes10..12 into a caller capability bitmap: zero=>PermissionDenied, nonzero=>accepted/preserved ROOT or arbitrary bits, sometimes before payload bounds. Current v1 header encodes zero in those reserved bytes and rejects any nonzero with ReservedNonZero; no caller-auth capability word exists. Reject exactly those bitmap/sentinel/precedence expectations without adding auth, ABI fields or permission behavior. Per-command flag validity and exact framing assertions: Positive encode/decode fixtures using arbitrary/all flags, Health0x55AA or flags0xFFFF conflict with CommandFlags reserved-global0xFF00 and per-command valid masks. Keep exact magic/version/command/correlation/length/byte roundtrip and rejection-field intents using a valid command/flag pair; invalid flags need the actual ReservedBitsSet/InvalidCommandFlags result, not weakened validation.

Reject exactly those bitmap/sentinel/precedence expectations without adding auth, ABI fields or permission behavior.
